_comment: Features the production client ships. A build missing any of these is a downgrade, however green the build looks. Strings are checked against the emitted bundle, case-sensitively. Keep this list to user-visible text that belongs to one feature, so a failure names the feature that vanished.
baseline: live bundle at mail.slothlee.xyz, 2026-11-18 (index-BWTHVBwE.js, Settings-CT-b9i2Y.js, Admin-1Oj5voM0.js, ComposeWindow-Cd-3eI-Y.js)

features.why: The wire multiplies a picked file by 3.65 (base64 in the MIME, base64 in the envelope, one seal per recipient), so a limit written in file bytes must be divided by that. The budget is counted per message, and a refusal names the sizes.
features.label: The composer accepts a measured per-message attachment budget

features.why: Snoozing puts a message out of every folder until a chosen time.
must: Snoozing needs the latest mail server

features.why: Named mailboxes read several addresses as one inbox.
An admin can switch an account off and back on.
A new account's one-time password is shown once and can be copied as a message.
Mail can be imported from another provider's archive.
Deleted mail is recoverable until the trash is emptied.
A locked mailbox is a state with a way out: a strip, a calm reader card, and never an error telling the user to log out.
A query reaches beyond the loaded page, and the bar answers the shortcut it prints.
must: Searching the rest of the mailbox

features.why: Every empty state offers the action that ends it, and composer fields carry accessible names.

On a phone an opened message takes the whole screen, with its own back control and the action bar pinned to the bottom. It replaces inline reading, which left the list visible above and below and clipped the body to roughly 250px — the owner reported mail cut off mid-sentence.
